query: What is the punishment for murder under Indian law?
key_facts: Murder is punishable under Section 302 IPC
The punishment is death or imprisonment for life, and also a fine
reference_answer: Under Section 302 IPC, whoever commits murder is punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

query: Can I get bail for a non-bailable offence?
key_facts: Bail in non-bailable offences is governed by Section 437 CrPC
A court may grant bail except in certain cases punishable with death or life imprisonment
reference_answer: Section 437 CrPC allows a court to grant bail in non-bailable offences, subject to restrictions where the offence is punishable with death or life imprisonment.

query: How do I file an RTI application to get information from a government office?
key_facts: An RTI request is filed under Section 6 RTI Act 2005 with the Public Information Officer
Information must generally be provided within 30 days
reference_answer: Under Section 6 RTI Act 2005 you file a written request with the Public Information Officer along with the prescribed fee, and the information must generally be provided within 30 days.

query: My cheque bounced due to insufficient funds. What legal action can be taken?
key_facts: Dishonour of a cheque for insufficient funds is an offence under Section 138 NI Act
The payee must send a demand notice within 30 days of dishonour
reference_answer: Dishonour of a cheque for insufficient funds is punishable under Section 138 NI Act; the payee must issue a demand notice within 30 days and may file a complaint if payment is not made within 15 days.

query: What is the law against dowry harassment by a husband and in-laws?
key_facts: Cruelty to a woman by her husband or his relatives is punishable under Section 498A IPC
Punishment may extend to three years imprisonment and fine
reference_answer: Section 498A IPC punishes cruelty, including dowry harassment, by a husband or his relatives with imprisonment up to three years and fine.

query: FIR दर्ज कराने से पुलिस मना कर दे तो क्या करें?
key_facts: संज्ञेय अपराध में FIR धारा 154 CrPC के तहत दर्ज होती है
पुलिस मना करे तो पुलिस अधीक्षक या मजिस्ट्रेट के पास शिकायत की जा सकती है
reference_answer: संज्ञेय अपराध की FIR Section 154 CrPC के तहत दर्ज होनी चाहिए; पुलिस मना करे तो पीड़ित पुलिस अधीक्षक या संबंधित मजिस्ट्रेट के पास शिकायत कर सकता है।

query: Online shopping me defective product mila, consumer complaint kaise file karun?
key_facts: Consumer complaints are filed under the Consumer Protection Act 2019
A complaint can be filed online on the e-Daakhil portal
reference_answer: Defective product ke liye aap Consumer Protection Act 2019 ke tahat District Consumer Commission me ya e-Daakhil portal par online complaint file kar sakte hain.

query: Landlord bina notice ke ghar khali karwa sakta hai kya?
key_facts: Eviction requires due legal process and notice under the applicable Rent Control Act
A tenant cannot be forcibly evicted without a court order
reference_answer: Landlord aapko bina proper notice aur court order ke evict nahi kar sakta; eviction applicable Rent Control Act ke tahat legal process se hi hota hai.

query: अटक होण्याआधी अटकपूर्व जामीन कसा मिळतो?
key_facts: Anticipatory bail is granted under Section 438 CrPC
It protects a person from arrest in anticipation of a non-bailable offence accusation
reference_answer: अटकपूर्व जामीन Section 438 CrPC अंतर्गत सत्र न्यायालय किंवा उच्च न्यायालयाकडून मिळतो, ज्यामुळे अजामीनपात्र गुन्ह्यात अटकेपासून संरक्षण मिळते.

query: வீட்டு வன்முறையிலிருந்து பாதுகாப்பு பெற என்ன சட்டம் உள்ளது?
key_facts: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005 provides civil remedies
A woman can seek a protection order from the magistrate
expected_citation: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005
reference_answer: வீட்டு வன்முறையிலிருந்து பெண்கள் Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005 மூலம் பாதுகாப்பு உத்தரவு மற்றும் நிவாரணம் பெறலாம்.

query: విడాకుల తర్వాత భార్యకు భరణం (maintenance) ఎలా వస్తుంది?
key_facts: Maintenance can be claimed under Section 125 CrPC
It applies to a wife, children and parents unable to maintain themselves
reference_answer: భార్య, పిల్లలు లేదా తల్లిదండ్రులు తమను తాము పోషించుకోలేనప్పుడు Section 125 CrPC కింద భరణం (maintenance) కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు.

query: ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਦੇ ਝਗੜੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਲਈ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਧਾਰਾ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਹੈ?
key_facts: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property is punishable under Section 420 IPC
Punishment may extend to seven years imprisonment and fine
reference_answer: ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਈਮਾਨੀ ਨਾਲ ਜਾਇਦਾਦ ਹਾਸਲ ਕਰਨਾ Section 420 IPC ਅਧੀਨ ਸਜ਼ਾਯੋਗ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੱਤ ਸਾਲ ਤੱਕ ਦੀ ਕੈਦ ਅਤੇ ਜੁਰਮਾਨਾ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

query: પોલીસ કોઈને કેટલા સમય સુધી કસ્ટડીમાં રાખી શકે?
key_facts: An arrested person must be produced before a magistrate within 24 hours under Section 57 CrPC
Detention beyond 24 hours requires a magistrate's authorisation
reference_answer: Section 57 CrPC મુજબ ધરપકડ કરાયેલ વ્યક્તિને 24 કલાકની અંદર મેજિસ્ટ્રેટ સમક્ષ રજૂ કરવો પડે છે, અને તેનાથી વધુ અટકાયત માટે મેજિસ્ટ્રેટની મંજૂરી જરૂરી છે.
